title: 'It took me a few minutes to process what I was seeing': local sailor recounts Loch Ness Monster encounter
excerpt: A local sailor has described spotting something ”I can only explain as a large oversized crocodile head” while on Loch Ness.
content:
A local sailor has described spotting something that looked like a “large oversized crocodile head” while on Loch Ness.

The unnamed sailor’s account is the 17th sighting of Nessie to be recorded on the Official Loch Ness Monster Sightings Register - in what is turning out to be a bumper year for encounters with the legendary beast. In the whole of 2025 there were only 10.

The sailor’s brush with the fabled water horse took place on July 25, but has only now been added to the register.

READ MORE: Loch Ness Monster spotted from space?

Recounting his sighting on the register the sailor, who was taking his yacht through the loch when he spotted the mysterious object at around 4pm.

"[I] spotted what I can only explain as a large oversized crocodile head above the water off the starboard quarter at distance of around 100 metres,” he said.

“At the time we were about two miles west of Glenmoriston, sea state was slight and visibility good. Our position was in the middle of the loch with the head sighting between us and the north shore.

“The head quickly disappeared before I could get a photo as it took me a few minutes to process what I was seeing. We made it into Fort Augustus safely with no further sightings."
